title: Rectangular QAM Modulator Baseband
text: Modulate using rectangular quadrature amplitude modulation, 1 input, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Output data type; {M-ary number} sets the modulation order, {Input type}, {Constellation ordering} sets the mapping order, {Constellation mapping} sets the user-defined constellation mapping, {Normalization method} sets the scaling method for constellation Min. distance between, {Minimum distance} sets the distance between two nearest constellation, {Average power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)}, {Peak power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} sets the maximum power, {Phase offset (rad)} sets the rotation of signal constellation and {View constellation} sets the option to plot reference constellation. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Constellation ordering
params.values: Mapping order of symbols Gray (default) | Binary | User-defined

params.name: Normalization method
params.values: Scaling method for constellation Min. distance between symbols (default) | Average Power | Peak Power

params.name: Minimum distance
params.values: Distance between two nearest constellation points 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: Rotation of signal constellation 0 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: View constellation
params.values: Option to plot reference constellation button

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | single | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation |
